captions.detailed: A roof-mounted CCTV security system featuring a central gray mast supported by four thin black guy-wires anchored to a wide gray rectangular base plate. At the top of the mast sits a black PTZ (pan-tilt-zoom) camera housing connected to a white camera body. The camera unit is designed to pan horizontally on a vertical revolute axis and tilt vertically on a horizontal revolute axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a roof CCTV pole with a guyed mast. The assembly should feature a rectangular base, a central vertical mast supported by four guy-wires, and a top-mounted PTZ camera housing configured to pan on a vertical revolute joint and tilt on a horizontal revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct a flat rectangular box for the base and a central vertical cylinder for the mast. Model the guy-wires using thin, angled cylinders or swept paths connecting the upper mast collar to small anchor blocks on the base. Assemble the camera housing using a combination of boxes and cylinders for the panning mount, and attach the main camera body using a horizontal cylindrical pivot to establish the tilting mechanism.
